_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

grant_usd.basis: the WoodNext Foundation grant, dollars, from '$2 million'

nsf_obligated_usd.basis: NSF funds obligated to the ARM-MIP award, dollars

nsf_total_usd.basis: NSF estimated total for the ARM-MIP award, dollars

award_months.basis: computed: whole calendar months from the start date to the end date, the last month counted when the end date falls at its end

max_temp_c.basis: degrees Celsius the university says existing self driving labs can't handle

papers_together.basis: papers Karaman and Arróyave have published together, a floor

button_unit_usd.basis: a drawing rule: one alloy button stands for this many dollars. Not a claim

grant_buttons.basis: computed: grant_usd divided by the drawing unit

nsf_obligated_buttons.basis: computed: nsf_obligated_usd divided by the drawing unit

nsf_total_buttons.basis: computed: nsf_total_usd divided by the drawing unit

nsf_total_over_grant.basis: computed: the NSF estimated total divided by the WoodNext grant, to one decimal place

nsf_obligated_share_pct.basis: computed: obligated over estimated total, as a whole percent

nsf_total_money_m.basis: computed: NSF estimated total in millions
